figures.name: Indra

ability.name: Vajra Strike
ability.description: Deal 8 thunder damage to one enemy; remove all enemy storm buffs.

figures.description: King of the Vedic gods who slays the drought-serpent Vritra with his thunderbolt to release the rivers.

figures.name: Varuna

ability.name: Rta's Noose
ability.description: Bind one enemy who has violated law: they lose all stats and cannot act for 2 turns.

figures.description: God of the cosmic law (Rta) who watches all deeds with his thousand eyes and punishes moral transgressors.

figures.name: Agni

ability.name: Sacred Fire
ability.description: All sacrificial and magic abilities gain +3 power; purify all allies of darkness.

figures.description: God of the sacred fire who carries human prayers and offerings to the gods and purifies all he touches.

figures.name: Surya

ability.name: Solar Chariot
ability.description: Grant all allies +2 speed; dark-aligned enemies lose 2 power from sunlight.

figures.description: The sun god who drives his chariot drawn by seven horses across the sky, seeing all and healing all.

figures.name: Saraswati

ability.name: Vak (Sacred Speech)
ability.description: Grant one ally complete mastery of all abilities for 1 turn.

figures.description: Goddess of wisdom and sacred speech who presides over all arts, knowledge and flowing rivers of inspiration.

figures.name: Rudra

ability.name: Shining Archer
ability.description: Fire at one enemy dealing 6 damage; all enemies' defense is reduced by 2 from the storm.

figures.description: Fierce storm god and divine archer whose arrows bring both disease and healing, precursor of Shiva.

figures.name: Ushas

ability.name: First Light
ability.description: Remove all darkness and sleep effects; all allies gain +2 speed from the new day.

figures.description: The beautiful dawn goddess who drives away darkness each morning and awakens all living beings to a new day.

figures.name: Yama

ability.name: Dharma's Judgment
ability.description: Weigh one enemy's karma: if they have more dark abilities than light, deal 6 damage.

figures.description: The first mortal to die who became lord of the dead and dharmic judge, accompanied by his twin sister Yami.

figures.name: Vritra

ability.name: Water Hoard
ability.description: Lock all healing and water abilities for 2 turns until defeated.

figures.description: The cosmic serpent of drought who blocked all the rivers until Indra slew him with the Vajra.

figures.name: Vishvakarman

ability.name: Celestial Forge
ability.description: Grant one ally a divine weapon: +4 power for 1 battle.

figures.description: The divine craftsman of the gods who built their celestial palaces and forged divine weapons.

figures.name: Parjanya

ability.name: Rain Cloud
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all earth and nature allies; inflict wet status on all enemies.

figures.description: The rain cloud god who roars and fertilizes the earth with life-giving water.

figures.name: Maruts

ability.name: Storm Troop
ability.description: Deal 2 damage to all enemies simultaneously as a divine army.

figures.description: The divine storm warriors who accompany Indra, warriors of the sky who ride their chariots through thunderclouds.

figures.name: Ashvins

ability.name: Divine Physicians
ability.description: Fully heal one critically wounded ally; grant +2 to all healing effects this turn.

figures.description: The twin divine physicians who ride their chariot at dawn healing the sick and rescuing those in distress.

figures.name: Mitra

ability.name: Sacred Contract
ability.description: Your side cannot break alliances; enemy treachery abilities auto-fail.

figures.description: The Vedic god of friendship and contracts whose bond is inviolable and who governs the morning sun.

figures.name: Soma

ability.name: Amrita Drink
ability.description: Grant one ally +4 to magic for 2 turns and immunity to death for 1 turn.

figures.description: The divine drink of immortality and the moon god himself, pressed from mountain plants and drunk by the gods.

figures.name: Vayu

ability.name: Breath of Life
ability.description: All allies gain +3 speed; remove all poison and suffocation effects.

figures.description: God of wind and breath whose life force animates all living beings and whose son Hanuman inherits his speed.

figures.name: Aryaman

ability.name: Guest's Right
ability.description: Prevent one enemy from using treacherous or ambush abilities for 1 turn.

figures.description: The Vedic god of hospitality, nobility and the ancestral line who ensures proper social order.

figures.name: Pushan

ability.name: Path Finder
ability.description: Any ally can move to any position this turn; grant +2 speed to all.

figures.description: God of journeys and cattle who guides travelers along safe paths and ensures cattle return home.

figures.name: Tvashtri

ability.name: Master Shaper
ability.description: Change one card's stats: add 2 to any stat and remove 2 from another.

figures.description: The divine craftsman who fashioned Indra's thunderbolt and shapes all living forms into their natural bodies.

figures.name: Nirrti

ability.name: Dissolution
ability.description: Reduce all enemies' lowest stat by 2 from the creeping dissolution.

figures.description: Goddess of dissolution, death and misfortune who governs the dark forces at the southern direction.
